item.title: NHS patients are to get blood tests that aim to detect several cancers
item.body: NHS patients are to get blood tests designed to detect several different cancers at once. Work on one of the tests suggests it can detect seven types of cancer.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🩸 NHS patients are to get blood tests that aim to detect several cancers

NHS patients are to get blood tests designed to detect several different cancers at once. Work on one of the tests suggests it can detect seven types of cancer.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 4 November, 13:50
